blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Quantifying disease-associated renal tubular remodeling is challenging because tubular appearances are heterogeneous. We introduce TuMAP (Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics), a pipeline combining (1) dual-view foundation-model representations and provisional morphotype annotation, (2) compositional and within-morphotype pathomics, and (3) patient-level statistical inference. From 456,158 tubules in 358 PAS-stained kidney biopsy slides, TuMAP identified eight image-based morphotypes, seven of which showed stable subsampling assignments. Across 219 patients in six diagnostic groups, diabetic nephropathy (DN) and tubulointerstitial nephritis/acute tubular injury (TIN/ATI) each differed from minimal change disease in seven morphotype proportions, while IgA nephropathy differed in six. DN showed reduced nuclear solidity and increased eccentricity across all eight morphotypes. Area-normalized nuclear density exposed additional within-morphotype differences. TuMAP provides a framework for separating changes in tubular morphotype composition from phenotypic differences within morphotypes.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Renal tubular remodeling is a major manifestation of kidney disease, yet its histopathological assessment remains largely semi-quantitative [ 1 ] . Recent computational pathology methods enable large-scale renal structure segmentation and morphometry [ 9 , 5 ] , including patient-level tubular analysis [ 4 ] , individual tubule characterization [ 7 ] , and histological phenotype discovery [ 13 , 6 ] . However, an integrated quantitative pipeline for systematically characterizing disease-associated tubular remodeling remains lacking.
blocks.zh: 肾管重塑是肾病的主要表现,但其组织病理学评估基本上仍然是半定量的[1]. 近期的计算病理学方法使得能进行大规模的肾脏结构分解和发作[9,5],包括患者级管状分析[4],单个管状特征[7],以及组织型苯基发现[13,6]. 然而,仍然缺乏一个综合定量管道,用以系统地描述与疾病有关的管状再生。

blocks.en: Three challenges remain: representing texture and shape despite slide variation; separating changes in morphotype composition from differences within morphotypes; and avoiding pseudoreplication when inferring disease associations from correlated tubules [ 16 , 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 仍然存在三个挑战:尽管有滑行变化,但仍代表了纹理和外形;将病原体成分的变化同病原体内部的差异区分开来;在推断疾病关联时避免了假复制[16、21]。

blocks.en: We present TuMAP (Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics) , a framework linking object-level morphological characterization to patient-level inference, inspired by single-cell differential abundance and pseudobulk analysis [ 14 ] . By examining morphotype composition and interpretable phenotypes within morphotypes separately, TuMAP assesses whether disease-associated differences involve changes in the mixture of tubular appearances, alterations within broadly similar groups, or both. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们提出Tumap (Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics),这个框架将物体级形态特征与病人级推论联系起来,灵感来自单细胞分化丰度和伪bulk分析[14]. TUMAP通过分别检查多发型内的多发型组成和可解释性苯基,评估了与疾病有关的差异是否涉及管状外观的混合物中的变化,大致相似的组内的变化,或者两者兼有. 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • Dual-View Tubular Representation: Integrating foundation model-derived texture and shape embeddings with cross-slide harmonization for unsupervised morphotype discovery. • Dual-Level Morphotype-Aware Pathomics: Quantifying both disease-associated morphotype compositional shifts and within-morphotype tubular and nuclear morphological alterations. • Patient-Level Statistical Inference: Combining patient-level aggregation, covariate-adjusted regression, and sensitivity analyses for disease association analysis while avoiding pseudoreplication.
blocks.zh: • 双视管 代表: 将地基模型衍生出纹理和外形嵌入与跨滑坡相协调,以进行无监督的多发型发现. • 双层摩尔phory-Aware路径学: 量化与疾病有关的多发型组成变化和形态内管和核形态变化。 • 病人一级的统计 推论:结合患者层次的聚合,同位相变调整回归,以及敏感度分析进行疾病关联分析,同时避免伪复制.

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Study Cohort and Data Preparation
blocks.zh: 2.1 研究科室和数据准备

blocks.en:
The Taipei Renal Transcriptomics and Outcomes Investigation
(TRTOI), a prospective cohort established in 2018, provided
363 PAS-stained native kidney biopsy slides from 362 patients
(0.221–0.230 µm/pixel). After quality control, 358 slides/357 patients entered diagnosis-agnostic discovery; 351 had pathology reports. Patients were grouped by unambiguous primary diagnosis; accompanying tubular, interstitial or vascular findings were permitted, but additional glomerular diseases excluded cases from MCD, DN, MN, LN and IgAN groups. The comparison comprised 219 patients with diabetic nephropathy (DN), IgA nephropathy (IgAN), membranous nephropathy (MN), lupus nephritis (LN), minimal change disease (MCD), or tubulointerstitial nephritis/acute tubular injury (TIN/ATI); 132 others contributed only to discovery (Table 1 ). MCD was a diseased reference; eight of 23 MCD patients had accompanying ATI/TIN. GS% required at least five manually annotated glomeruli.

台北雷纳尔语拼音和结果调查
(TRTOI),成立于2018年的预期组群,提供
363个PAS有斑点的本地肾活体活体检查从362个病人中滑出
(0.221–0.230μm/像素). 在质量控制后,358个幻灯片/357个病人进入诊断-不可知性发现;351个病人有病理学报告。 患者被归类为明确的初级诊断;随附的管状、间歇性或血管性诊断是允许的,但其他的光性疾病不包括在MCD、DN、MN、LN和IgAN群体中。 比较对象包括219名糖尿病性肾上腺炎(DN)、IgA肾上腺炎(IgAN)、中性肾上腺炎(MN)、狼肾炎(LN)、最小变化性疾病(MCD)或输卵管间质性肾上腺炎/急性输卵管损伤(TIN/ATI);另外132名仅有助于发现(表1)。 儿童疾病是一种疾病参考;23名儿童疾病患者中有8人随同ATI/TIN。 GS%至少需要5个手动附加说明的光彩。

blocks.en: 2.2 Dual-View Tubular Representation
blocks.zh: 2.2 双视管代表

blocks.en: An in-house pipeline based on YOLOv12 and SAM 2 [ 17 , 15 ] segmented tubules. Texture and contour-masked shape crops ( 224 2 224^{2} pixels; 0.45 µm/pixel) were encoded by frozen UNI2-h [ 3 ] ; the concatenated 3,072-D embeddings were ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized, reduced by PCA to 50 dimensions, slide-centered, and integrated with Harmony [ 8 ] . Leiden clustering [ 18 ] used 25 nearest neighbors (resolution 0.5). Stability was tested by 80% subsampling (ARI/Jaccard). In an 11-slide/42,827-tubule pilot, dual views improved slide-held-out R 2 R^{2} for major axis (0.83 vs. 0.74/0.82) and Haralick texture (0.62 vs. 0.60/0.57 for texture/shape alone).
blocks.zh: 以YOLOv12和SAM 2 [17,15]分管为主的内部管道. 纹理和等宽相模外形作物(224 224^{2}像素;0.45μm/像素)由被冷冻的UNI2-h [3]编码;被冷冻的3,072-D嵌入是l 2\ell_{2}——正态化,被PCA缩小为50维,以滑动为中心,并和和谐相融合 [8]. Leiden集群 [18] 使用了25个最近的邻居(第0.5号决议). 通过80%的分采样(ARI/Jaccard)测试了稳定性。 在11-slip/42,827-tubule试验中,双视图改进了主要轴线(0.83对0.74/0.82)和哈拉利克纹理(0.62对0.60/0.57单指纹理/形状)的滑行-控出R2R^{2}。

blocks.en:
Provisional morphotype annotation. M1–M8 were annotated along three descriptive axes: segment-like identity (proximal-like, distal-like, or indeterminate), sectioning plane (transverse, longitudinal, oblique, or indeterminate), and lesion pattern (including atrophy-like change, dilation, and casts). The designation no overt lesion does not imply normality; sizes distinguish otherwise similar appearances. Uncertain axes remained indeterminate, and labels describe
predominant rather than universal cluster features
(Fig. 2 ).

blocks.en: 2.3 Dual-Level Morphotype-Aware Pathomics
blocks.zh: 2.3 双层摩photype-Award Pathomics

blocks.en: TuMAP analyzes two levels: Level I: Morphotype composition , the patient-level morphotype proportions, and Level II: Morphotype-conditioned morphology , tubular and nuclear features within each morphotype.
blocks.zh: TOMAP 分析两个级别: 一级:多发型组成 患者-多发型比例 二级:多发型有条件形态 ,管状和核状特征 每个多发型内.

blocks.en:
PySpatial [ 20 ] yielded 119 tubular shape, intensity, Haralick texture, and radial features, excluding rotation/reflection-sensitive features (ICC < 0.75 <0.75 ). Nuclei were segmented using a Cellpose-SAM [ 12 ] checkpoint fine-tuned on expert-annotated challenging kidney nuclei
in our prior work [ 19 ] .
Nuclei were assigned to tubules by centroid inclusion
within contours dilated by 2 µm. We extracted 97 nuclear features after Macenko stain deconvolution [ 10 ] , excluding nuclei deeper than 15 µm inside original contours for nuclear morphology. Separately, nuclear density was defined per tubule as all assigned nuclei divided by original contour area (including lumen), expressed per 10,000 µm 2 , without the 15-µm depth filter.
blocks.zh:
PySpatial [20] 产生了119个管状形状、强度、Haralick纹理和射线特征,不包括旋转/反射敏感特征(ICC < 0.75<0.75)。 核心用一个细胞-SAM[12]检查点进行分解,对专家说明的有挑战性的肾核进行微调
我们以前的工作[19]。
核糖体被分配到管子上 包括了中间行星
以2微米为单位放大。 我们在Macenko污迹分解后提取出97个核特征 [10],不包括核子深于15微米的原轮廓内核形态. 单独地,每个管子的核密度被定义为所有被分配的核除以原同位素区域(包括lumen),以每10,000μm 2 表示,而无15μm深度过滤器.

blocks.en: 2.4 Patient-Level Statistical Inference
blocks.zh: 2.4 病人一级的统计推论

blocks.en: To avoid pseudoreplication, TuMAP aggregates measurements at the patient level using one slide per patient. Morphotype counts x i ​ k x_{ik} among N i N_{i} patient tubules were transformed using a continuity-corrected logit [ 14 ] : z i ​ k = logit ⁡ ( x i ​ k + 0.5 N i + 1 ) . z_{ik}=\operatorname{logit}\left(\frac{x_{ik}+0.5}{N_{i}+1}\right). Within each morphotype, patient medians summarized tubular features ( ≥ 10 \geq 10 tubules), nuclear features ( ≥ 30 \geq 30 qualifying nuclei), and per-tubule nuclear density (without a minimum-tubule threshold).

Standardized patient-level outcomes were regressed on diagnosis (MCD reference), scan-resolution group, and acquisition year; composition additionally adjusted for annotated glomeruli per 1,000 tubules. Effects are in SD units with 95% confidence intervals from HC3 robust standard errors [ 11 ] . Benjamini–Hochberg FDR ( q < 0.05 q<0.05 ) was controlled by diagnostic contrast within composition, tubular, nuclear, and nuclear-density feature families [ 2 ] . Within-morphotype tests included 208–219 patients, depending on available measurements.
blocks.zh: 在诊断(MCD参考)、扫描分辨率组和购置年份,病人一级标准化结果出现后退;再根据每1 000个管子中附加说明的光度调整组成。 效应在自毁装置中,来自HC3强标准误差的95%的置信间隔[11]. Benjamini-Hochberg FDR(q < 0.05 q < 0.05)在组成、管状、核和核密度特征家族内部通过诊断对比加以控制[2]。 形态内型检测包括208–219名患者,视现有测量结果而定.

blocks.en: Sensitivity analyses compared GS%-adjusted and unadjusted models in the same 190 patients, restricted diagnoses, excluded DN with arterionephrosclerosis, and imposed a stricter tubule-detection confidence threshold ( ≥ 0.93 \geq 0.93 ).
blocks.zh: 敏感性分析比较了同一190名患者的GS%调整和未调整模型,有限制的诊断,排除了DN与动脉内膜硬化,并规定了更严格的管状检测置信阈值(^ 0.93\geq 0.93)。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 1. Unsupervised Tubular Morphotype Discovery. Diagnosis-agnostic clustering of 456,158 tubules from 358 slides identified eight provisional image-derived morphotypes (Fig. 2 ): proximal-like M1–M3, distal-like M4–M5, atrophy-like M6, small transverse M7, and cast-containing M8. Median areas spanned 426–7,600 μ ​ m 2 \mu\mathrm{m}^{2} . Morphotypes were broadly distributed across slides (effective slide diversity 192–293; maximum single-slide share 2.1%). Subsampling yielded ARI 0.75 ± 0.07 0.75\pm 0.07 and Jaccard indices of 0.69–0.91 for seven morphotypes (M6: 0.51). M6–M8 proportions correlated positively with GS% ( ρ = 0.61 \rho=0.61 – 0.68 0.68 ), while proximal-like proportions correlated negatively ( ρ = − 0.29 \rho=-0.29 to − 0.58 -0.58 ).
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 无所监督的通管摩诃般若觉. 358个幻灯片的456,158个管子的诊断-不可知集解确定了8个临时成像衍生出发型(图2):近似M1-M3,异似M4-M5,萎缩相似M6,小横切相似M7,并有铸造的M8. 介质区域横跨了426-7,600 μ m 2\mu\ mathrm{ m}^{2}. 摩尔phortype在幻灯片中广泛分布(有效的幻灯片多样性192–293;最大单滑份额2.1%)。 次采样得出了7个发作型(M6:0.51)的ARI 0.75±0.07 0.75\pm 0.07和Jaccard指数为0.69-0.91. M6-M8比例与GS%呈正比关系(ρ=0.61\rho=0.61=0.68 0.68),而相近比例则呈负比关系(ρ=-0.29\rho=-0.29至-0.58).

blocks.en: 2. Disease-Associated Morphotype Composition. Compared with MCD, DN and TIN/ATI each differed in seven of eight morphotype proportions, IgAN in six, and MN and LN in one each (M7 and M8, respectively; Fig. 3 (a)). In DN, mean M6 share increased from 5.5% to 20.1% ( + 2.00 +2.00 SD; 95% CI, 1.63–2.37), M8 from 1.9% to 9.0% ( + 1.78 +1.78 SD), and M7 from 6.6% to 13.1% ( + 1.52 +1.52 SD). All three proximal-like shares declined, including M2 (15.3% to 7.4%; − 1.56 -1.56 SD).
blocks.zh: 2. 与疾病有关的摩托型构成。 与MCD相比,DN和TIN/ATI在八分之七的比例上各有不同,IgAN为六分之一,MN和LN为一分之一(分别为M7和M8;图3(a))。 在DN中,M6的平均份额从5.5%增至20.1%(+ 2.00+ 2.00 SD;95% CI,1.63–2.37;M8从1.9%增至9.0%(+1.78+1.78 SD);M7从6.6%增至13.1%(+1.52 SD)。 所有三种相近的股份都有所下降,包括M2(15.3%至7.4%);−1.56-1.56 SD.

blocks.en: 3. Within-Morphotype Morphological Differences. Within morphotypes, DN nuclear solidity decreased (median − 1.06 -1.06 SD) and eccentricity increased ( + 0.88 +0.88 SD), each significant in all eight morphotypes; TIN/ATI showed corresponding differences in four and five, respectively (Fig. 3 (b–c)). DN tubular PAS intensity was lower in seven morphotypes. In proximal-like M1, predominantly annotated as lacking overt lesions, DN was associated with lower tubular solidity ( − 1.65 -1.65 SD; 95% CI, − 1.95 -1.95 to − 1.34 -1.34 ) and nuclear minor axis ( − 1.32 -1.32 SD; 95% CI, − 1.72 -1.72 to − 0.92 -0.92 ). M1 area-normalized nuclear density was higher in TIN/ATI ( + 1.26 +1.26 SD), DN ( + 0.81 +0.81 SD), IgAN ( + 0.50 +0.50 SD), and LN ( + 0.47 +0.47 SD; Fig. 3 (d–f)). Because density uses total tubular contour area, including lumen, increases need not indicate more nuclei.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: We introduced TuMAP, a morphotype-aware quantitative pathomics pipeline integrating dual-view tubular representation, dual-level morphological profiling, and patient-level statistical inference. Applied to 456,158 tubules, TuMAP identified eight morphotypes and revealed disease-associated changes in both morphotype composition and within-morphotype tubular and nuclear morphology. Notably, DN and TIN/ATI exhibited widespread remodeling at both levels, while adjustment for glomerulosclerosis attenuated several associations, highlighting the importance of pathological severity in disease comparisons. These morphotypes represent provisional image-based groups rather than validated nephron segments, warranting further histological validation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Tumap,一种多发型-发觉定量病理学管道, 结合了双视管代表, 双层形态特征分析, 以及病人一级的统计推论。 Tumap应用到456,158个管状管上,确定了8个发作型,并揭示出发作型成分和发作型内发作管和核生作形态上与疾病有关的变化. 值得注意的是,DN和TIN/ATI在两个级别上都表现出了广泛的再造,而光晕症的调整减弱了几个关联,突出了病理严重性在疾病比较中的重要性。 这些发作型代表了以影像为基础的临时群体,而不是经过验证的肾上腺分泌,值得进一步的神学验证.
